영.forms: Sino-Korean · scores, temperatures, decimals · in phone numbers: 공
영.x: It's zero degrees today, so it's really cold.
영.t: In phone numbers say 공 instead: 010 = 공일공.

학교.ex: 저는 아침 여덟 시에 학교에 가요.
학교.x: I go to school at eight in the morning.
학교.t: Pronounced [학꾜]: ㄱ after a ㄱ batchim becomes tense ㄲ.

춥다.x: It's cold today because the wind is blowing.
춥다.t: 춥다 is for weather or feeling cold; for cold drinks or objects use 차갑다.

검은색.ex: 면접 때는 보통 검은색 정장을 입어요.
검은색.x: People usually wear a black suit for job interviews.
검은색.e: From native 검다 'to be black' plus 색 'color'.
검은색.t: 까만색 and 검정색 mean the same; 검정 can also stand alone as a noun.

댁.m: home, house (honorific); you (to a stranger, distant)
댁.e: From hanja 宅 'house', the respectful word for someone else's home.
댁.t: The plain word is 집; say 댁 for the homes of elders, teachers or customers, but 저희 집 for your own. Used as 'you' (댁은 누구세요?) it sounds distant or even rude.

상품.x: This store sells a wide variety of goods.
상품.e: Literally 'trade goods'. A homonym 상품 (different hanja) means 'prize'.

이삿짐.ex: 이삿짐을 다 옮기는 데 하루가 걸렸어요.
이삿짐.x: It took a whole day to move all our stuff.
이삿짐.e: 이사 'moving' + 짐 'load, luggage,' joined by an extra ㅅ.
이삿짐.t: Pronounced [이사찜] or [이삳찜] — the added ㅅ makes 짐 tense.

억울하다.ex: 저는 잘못이 없는데 혼나서 너무 억울해요.
억울하다.x: I did nothing wrong but got scolded, so it feels so unfair.
억울하다.e: Literally 'pressed-down gloom': the frustration of unfair blame.
억울하다.t: No single English equivalent: use it when you are blamed or punished unfairly.

식료품.ex: 저는 주말마다 집 근처 마트에서 식료품을 사요.
식료품.x: I buy groceries at the supermarket near my house every weekend.
식료품.t: Pronounced [싱뇨품] — nasalization turns ㄱ+ㄹ into ㅇ+ㄴ.

업계.m: industry, the business world, the trade
업계.x: He worked in the game industry for ten years.
업계.e: Literally 'business world'; -계 = field or world: 업계, 교육계, 연예계.

붕괴.ex: 오래된 다리가 붕괴되어 많은 사람이 다쳤습니다.
붕괴.x: An old bridge collapsed, and many people were injured.
붕괴.t: The native verb is 무너지다; 붕괴 also works for systems, as in 경제 붕괴 'economic collapse'.

현기증.ex: 더운 날씨에 오래 서 있다가 현기증이 났어요.
현기증.x: I got dizzy after standing for a long time in the hot weather.
현기증.e: Literally 'dazed-energy symptom'. -증 = symptom or condition: 불면증, 우울증.
현기증.t: Pronounced [현기쯩]; the usual verb is 나다: 현기증이 나다.

집요하다.ex: 그는 집요하게 전화를 걸어서 결국 답을 받았어요.
집요하다.x: He kept calling relentlessly and finally got an answer.
집요하다.t: Usually more negative than 끈질기다, suggesting someone who just won't let it go.

얽히다.m: to get tangled; to be entangled, be involved (in)
얽히다.ex: 이어폰 줄이 가방 안에서 엉망으로 얽혔어요.
얽히다.x: My earphone cord got all tangled up in my bag.
얽히다.e: Passive of 얽다 'to bind, tie together'.

정체.x: It's rush hour, so traffic is really backed up.
정체.e: Literally 'stopping and stagnating.' Homonym warning: 정체 also means 'true identity.'
정체.t: Common in traffic reports: 정체가 심하다 'heavy congestion'; in speech, 길이 막혀요 is more natural.

준결승.ex: 우리 팀은 아쉽게도 준결승에서 지고 말았어요.
준결승.x: Unfortunately, our team lost in the semifinal.
준결승.t: Rounds are counted by teams left: 16강, 8강, 4강 (= 준결승).

준우승.ex: 아쉽게 우승은 못 했지만 준우승을 했어요.
준우승.x: Sadly we didn't win, but we took second place.

등반.ex: 이번 주말에 친구들과 설악산 등반을 해요.
등반.x: This weekend I'm climbing Seoraksan with friends.
등반.t: 등산 is everyday hiking; 등반 suggests a serious climb, like Everest or rock walls.

감수성.ex: 그 아이는 감수성이 풍부해서 작은 일에도 잘 울어요.
감수성.x: That child is very sensitive, so she cries easily even over small things.
감수성.t: Collocation: 감수성이 풍부하다 'be very sensitive, emotional' — usually a compliment.

덮어놓고.ex: 사정도 모르면서 덮어놓고 화를 내면 어떡해요?
덮어놓고.x: How can you just get angry without even knowing the situation?
덮어놓고.e: Literally 'having covered (it) up': not looking at the facts.
덮어놓고.t: Pronounced [더퍼노코]; common collocation 덮어놓고 믿다 'to trust blindly'.

까마득히.x: I completely forgot about my plans with my friend.
까마득히.t: Key collocation: 까마득히 잊다 'to forget completely'.

인지적.ex: 꾸준한 독서는 아이의 인지적 발달에 도움이 됩니다.
인지적.x: Regular reading helps a child's cognitive development.

초가집.ex: 민속촌에 가면 옛날 초가집을 구경할 수 있어요.
초가집.x: If you go to the folk village, you can see old thatched-roof houses.
초가집.e: Sino 초가 'grass house' + native 집 'house'. Contrasts with 기와집.

등수.ex: 저는 등수보다 실력이 더 중요하다고 생각해요.
등수.x: I think real skill matters more than your rank.
등수.t: 등수 is more casual than 석차 and also works for contests and races.

극우.ex: 유럽에서 극우 정당의 지지율이 오르고 있습니다.
극우.x: Support for far-right parties is rising in Europe.
극우.t: Pronounced [그구]: the ㄱ moves over to the next syllable.

핵실험.ex: 북한의 핵실험에 대해 유엔이 강하게 규탄했습니다.
핵실험.x: The UN strongly condemned North Korea's nuclear test.

위궤양.ex: 아버지는 위궤양 때문에 매운 음식을 못 드세요.
위궤양.x: My father can't eat spicy food because of his stomach ulcer.
위궤양.t: 위 + illness is a handy pattern: 위염 (gastritis), 위암 (stomach cancer).

무선통신.x: Smartphones use a variety of wireless communication technologies.
무선통신.e: Literally 'no-wire communication'; the opposite is 유선 'wired.'

관현악.ex: 이 영화 음악은 웅장한 관현악으로 연주되었어요.
관현악.x: This film score was performed as grand orchestral music.
관현악.e: Literally 'pipe and string music': winds plus strings.

중인.m: jungin, the middle class (technical specialists in Joseon)
중인.ex: 조선 시대 중인은 통역관이나 의원 같은 일을 했어요.
중인.x: In the Joseon era, the jungin worked as interpreters, doctors and the like.
중인.e: Literally 'middle people', between the yangban aristocrats and commoners.

신재생에너지.x: The government said it would increase the share of new and renewable energy.
신재생에너지.e: 신 'new' (hydrogen, fuel cells) + 재생 'renewable' (solar, wind) + English 'energy'.

풍수지탄.m: regret at being unable to care for parents who have died
풍수지탄.x: Only after my parents passed away did I feel the regret of not caring for them enough.
풍수지탄.e: The tree wants stillness but the wind won't stop; the child wants to serve, but parents are gone.

전두엽.ex: 전두엽은 판단과 감정 조절에 중요한 역할을 합니다.
전두엽.x: The frontal lobe plays an important role in judgment and emotional control.
전두엽.e: Literally 'front head leaf'. -엽 = lobe: 측두엽, 후두엽.
